reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which every server and desktop-client consumer already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the range rule is redefined once.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where it already was; call sites only get comment updates.

scope.why: The rule, matching comment updates at the call sites and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; the round parameter is kept although it is now nearly meaningless for an endpoint of integer amounts, a small leftover.

bypasses_abstraction.where: None; all ranged-amount sites go through getScheduledAmount.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by forecast-schedules, schedules/app (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), schedule-template, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and the desktop-client views.
